scope: Rear IMX179 on mainline: new sensor driver, MMCC MCLK fix, CAMSS without IOMMU (probe kernel = r8 + fixes, RAM boot; installed system unchanged)

mclk.finding: mmcc-msm8974 mclk0-3 RCGs lack .mnd_width, so the 24 MHz entry (GPLL0/5 x 1/5) yields 120 MHz; the vendor driver programs these RCGs with M/N
mclk.fix: fx0-linux da66f6c0bdf6 adds .mnd_width = 8 to mclk0-3_clk_src (also present upstream in qcom for-next)

sensor.id: 0x8179 at register 0x0002 over CCI (matches the vendor slave-id <0x20 0x0002 0x8179>)
sensor.driver: fx0-linux integration/fx0-camss drivers/media/i2c/imx179.c (3280x2464 RAW10, 4 lanes, 324 MHz link, 30 fps; Tegra GPL register table)
sensor.live: captured data at black level 0x10 (10-bit 64) with varying low bits; image content not yet verified

camss_without_iommu.tpg: CSID test pattern data at 8-bit and 10-bit packed, 1280x720 and 3280x2464
camss_without_iommu.truncation: each frame contains data only in its first rows (live 3280x2464: 574 of 2464 rows; TPG 720p 8-bit about half the rows), suggesting a VFE write-bandwidth or AXI clock limit

vfe_iommu: with the VFE IOMMU attached, captures complete but the buffers stay all zero; the qcom,msm8226-vfe-iommu configuration does not translate correctly yet
open: VFE AXI/bus clock rate and full-frame capture
verify image content (debayer/stride), exposure and gain mapping
